title: Carrera Evolution / Digital 132 / Digital 124

scope.basis: All track-bearing products and associated borders on Carrera 2024 pages 88–90, 94–95, 97–98, plus 20515 and selected legacy 20516/30344.
excluded: Other Carrera families: GO, First, Hybrid, Universal, Servo, Pro-X electronics
Cosmetic-only limited-edition prints of an existing geometry
Buildings, figures, cars, hand controllers, transformers, cables and loose support hardware
Guardrails and scenery envelopes: separate accessory pack, not included in fit validation
Unpublished or future pieces; add as a versioned community extension
scope.availability: Catalogue presence does not assert present-day retail availability.

defaults.evidence: Outer-radius progression of 400/600/800/1000 mm is shown, rounded, in the manufacturer catalogue. This nominal drawing grid is not exact physical measurement.
defaults.previousStudy: The first study used provisional 198/99 mm parameters. Those files are preserved; no saved layout should be silently rescaled.

sources.title: Carrera 2025 Czech catalogue
sources.note: Supplementary published listing; not a claim of exhaustive 2026 stock availability.

authoring.spacingDefinition: Distance between adjacent slot centre lines, in mm. Independent of track width.
authoring.spacingCompatibility: Compare actual ordered lane positions in connector coordinates; incompatible profiles require an adapter.
authoring.savedLayoutPolicy: Embed immutable piece definition, revision and dimensions. Edits create a new revision.
authoring.specialPiecePolicy: User-defined arbitrary outlines, multiple ports and lane-path graphs are a future template. Do not infer routes from width and length alone.

outstanding: Manufacturer engineering dimensions were not located; nominal drawing grid is not certified physical geometry.
Special-piece SVGs are recognisable illustrations, not measured footprints or routing curves.
Banked and elevated sections lack documented height and banking profiles.
Product package contents with ambiguous wording are explicitly flagged.
